basic_info.description: Located in the heart of coveted, sunny Noe Valley, this beautiful top-level 2-bedroom condo, with home office, offers the perfect blend of modern convenience and timeless charm. Situated in a boutique 6-unit Edwardian building, the home is bathed in natural light and showcases beautiful original details, including rich hardwood floors, wainscoting, and high ceilings.  The sleek chef's kitchen is equipped with stainless steel appliances, sleek countertops, and abundant cabinetry, making it a culinary haven. Thoughtful updates like an in-unit washer and dryer provide modern-day comfort, while the lush, verdant backyard invites al fresco dining and outdoor relaxation. Start your mornings with coffee on your terrace, soaking in the quintessential San Francisco views. This home also includes a massive bonus flex space, which can be used as a fitness room, art studio, workshop, or as a huge storage space. Just minutes from the vibrant 24th Street corridor, you'll enjoy world-class dining, cozy cafes, charming boutiques, Whole Foods, parks, and more. Commuting is a breeze with easy access to tech shuttles, public transportation, and highways leading to Silicon Valley and downtown. This is San Francisco living at its finest.
